definition: speedup = baseline latency / optimized latency; <1 is slower

CPU cache operators.timing: Source compilation paused; local-sync, resident inputs, no output download, one invocation/sample, randomized order; 5warmups,7calibration and21holdout observations. Calibration seed613,holdout811; block weights fixed515.

CPU extensions.timing: No source builds or compilation during timing. Resident inputs, local-sync, no output downloads, torch1thread; randomized order,5warmups,7calibration(seed613),21holdout(seed811). Incorrect stock snapshot baseline excluded.

CPU projections.timing: Timing-only sequential confirmation, no concurrent compilation in this process, preuploaded inputs, no output download, local-sync; one invocation per sample. Candidate choices frozen from calibration.

CPU projection ablations.timing: Recorded per-variant microsecond medians; separate ablation run.

T4 earlier projection operators.timing: Synchronized invocation, execution and all output downloads; resident input upload excluded. Separate from final resident-output model timings.

T4 earlier cache attention operators.timing: Synchronized invocation, execution and all output downloads; best correct available IREE control chosen as baseline. No pooling with final resident-output timings.

T4 earlier cache block operators.timing: Synchronized invocation, execution and all output downloads; best correct available IREE control chosen as baseline. No pooling with final resident-output timings.

T4 earlier cache winner operators.timing: Synchronized invocation, execution and all output downloads; best correct available IREE control chosen as baseline. No pooling with final resident-output timings.

T4 earlier update-chain operators.timing: Synchronized invocation plus all output downloads; resident input upload excluded. Combined coalescing/forwarding forms, not coalescing-only ablations.

T4 final DRAM study A.timing: Unprofiled resident-output context-synchronized latency; median of repetition medians. Model: three prompts; synthetic: one case. Not pooled with earlier operator timings.

T4 final DRAM study B.timing: Unprofiled resident-output context-synchronized latency; median of repetition medians. Model: three prompts; synthetic: one case. Not pooled with earlier operator timings.

T4 earlier fusion ablation.timing: Earlier repaired-model run; median of valid repetition medians, kept separate from final DRAM study.
